name: Palette.fm
summary: AI colorizer that turns black-and-white photos into realistic color with 21+ adjustable filters.
description: AI colorizer that turns black-and-white photos into realistic color with 21+ adjustable filters.

pricing.details: Free 0 € — unlimited color previews resized to a maximum of 500×500 with a Palette logo watermark, plus 1 free trial credit for a logo-free full-resolution colorization (up to 5000×5000). Subscribe 65 €/year (officially also described as 5 €/month) — 480 credits/year, each credit one logo-free high-resolution colorization, unused credits roll over up to five times the monthly plan amount, credits valid while the subscription is active, cancel anytime. Pay once 44 € for 75 credits, valid 2 years. Other subscription sizes (2,400 and 6,000 credits) and other one-time packs appear in the UI without a clearly isolated list price and are left unlisted.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: More than 21 color filters, plus color adjustments and keyword-guided colorization
Free previews up to 500×500 with a watermark, and 1 trial credit for a full-resolution export
Yearly subscription (480 credits/year) or a one-time 75-credit pack, valid 2 years
Official site lists a Portugal address in the footer
